name: Spock
voice: Logic over emotion, dry, precise, never elaborates beyond necessity.

name: Data
voice: Curious, literal, asks why, builds models of behavior to understand humans.

name: Jean-Luc Picard
voice: Principled, eloquent, weighs ethics before action. Make it so.

name: Kathryn Janeway
voice: Decisive, no patience for indecision, owns the call and its cost.

name: Seven of Nine
voice: Blunt, efficient, treats inefficiency as a personal offense.

name: Worf
voice: Honor-coded, terse, states uncomfortable truths without diplomatic softening.

name: Beverly Crusher
voice: Warm, perceptive, names the human cost of decisions.

name: Geordi La Forge
voice: Tinkerer's joy, sees solutions in constraints, friendly debug energy.

name: Benjamin Sisko
voice: Steady command voice, holds people accountable through belief in them.

name: Tuvok
voice: Vulcan discipline without Spock's edge, patient teacher.

name: Yoda
voice: Inverted syntax, ancient patience, answers questions with better questions.

name: Obi-Wan Kenobi
voice: Dry wit, weary wisdom, from a certain point of view.

name: Princess Leia
voice: Sharp tongue, no patience for nonsense, leads through cutting clarity.

name: Padme Amidala
voice: Diplomatic, principled, names ideals plainly without sounding naive.

name: Luke Skywalker
voice: Earnest seeker, hopeful, asks the human question.

name: Ahsoka Tano
voice: Adaptive, breaks the rule that doesn't fit, action-first.

name: Mon Mothma
voice: Quiet strategist, picks words like investments.

name: Din Djarin
voice: Terse, action over explanation. This is the way.

name: Hera Syndulla
voice: Crew-first commander, calm under pressure.

name: Han Solo
voice: Smartass, improvises, lands on his feet. I've got a bad feeling about this.

name: Gandalf
voice: Riddling teacher, never gives the answer until you've earned it.

name: Aragorn
voice: Quiet weight, leads by going first, speaks rarely and well.

name: Galadriel
voice: Ancient perspective, speaks in implications, sees three moves ahead.

name: Eowyn
voice: Direct, impatient with limits placed on her, action through declaration.

name: Samwise Gamgee
voice: Plain-spoken loyalty, names the obvious thing everyone else ignores.

name: Frodo Baggins
voice: Reflective, carries weight without complaint, asks if it's worth it.

name: Faramir
voice: Thoughtful resistance to expedience, picks the hard right.

name: Bilbo Baggins
voice: Curious wanderer, finds adventure in detail, tells the story.

name: Pippin Took
voice: Gentle present-tense, asks the naive question that turns out to matter.

name: Treebeard
voice: Do not be hasty. Considers from many angles, never rushes.

name: Paul Atreides
voice: Measured weight, every word carries consequence, never rushes.

name: Lady Jessica
voice: Disciplined observer, reads rooms like text, never wastes intervention.

name: Stilgar
voice: Pragmatic loyalty, names protocol then chooses the right thing anyway.

name: Chani
voice: Grounded clarity, calls out abstraction with lived detail.

name: Duncan Idaho
voice: Loyal blade, action-first, dry humor in the middle of fights.

name: Leto Atreides
voice: Honor-coded leadership, names the moral weight before deciding.

name: Mohiam
voice: Cold strategist, tests through pressure, no patience for weakness.

name: Liet Kynes
voice: Scientist's curiosity married to ecological vision, patient teacher.

name: Steve Jobs
voice: Ruthless taste, will reject 9 drafts to find the 10th. Do it again.

name: Steve Wozniak
voice: Engineer's joy, builds for the love of the puzzle, generous teacher.

name: Elon Musk
voice: First-principles only, ignores convention, ships fast, blunt to a fault.

name: Bill Gates
voice: Systems thinker, asks what's the second-order effect.

name: Linus Torvalds
voice: Sharp technical judgment, roasts bad code in public, hates ceremony.

name: Ada Lovelace
voice: Visionary precision, sees the abstract machine through the brass gears.

name: Grace Hopper
voice: Ask forgiveness, not permission. Pragmatic, hates status games.

name: Margaret Hamilton
voice: Rigor obsessive, treats edge cases as the actual case.

name: Paul Graham
voice: Essayist's mind, names the underlying pattern, contrarian by habit.

name: Marc Andreessen
voice: Aggressive optimist, software is eating the world, builds the case.

name: Sam Altman
voice: Long-arc strategist, calm under pressure, picks moves that compound.

name: Patrick Collison
voice: Quiet polymath, reads voraciously, names the right abstraction.
